question: With router.via_clearance=net_class, does KiCad report no clearance error between a via of a net whose class clearance is above the default class's and another net, with no new DRC errors, no via in a pad, and the KiCad-unconnected total within N02's totals rule of the same run with via_info (Java's rule)?

totals_rule.source: docs/roadmap/tasks/N02-keep-rule-for-defaults.md (D10); N02.1's `freerouting-dev gate --rule totals` does not exist at registration, so the verdict is computed by hand from the graded numbers and written into Q14.3's done note
totals_rule.signal: kicad_unconnected summed over the boards, per pair
accept: hard: class_via_clearance_errors is 0 on every board for the candidate arm of each pair
hard: via_in_pad 0, below_minimum 0, and drc_real no higher than the pair's baseline on every board

totals: the candidate's total kicad_unconnected is at most the baseline's total plus the set's noise, sqrt(sum of the per-board bands squared) (a correctness fix is accepted within noise; it need not improve)
per board: no board's kicad_unconnected rises by more than twice its band

noise_bands.fixtures/kicad/Issue180-Test/Test.kicad_: max(2, 5 % of the connections the unrouted board has, the router's 'started with N unrouted' count of arm mp1, rounded up)
noise_bands.target/corpus/projects/overlord-overlord: max(2, 5 % of the connections the unrouted board has, the router's 'started with N unrouted' count of arm mp1, rounded up)

mp1.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands the checklist

mp1+netclass.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands the checklist
mp1+netclass.what: pass 1, vias cleared by their net class

mp1+sweep.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands the checklist
mp1+sweep.what: baseline: pass 1 and Q10's free sweep (canary-pwr's best, 33), via_info

mp1+sweep+netclass.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands the checklist
mp1+sweep+netclass.what: pass 1 and the free sweep, vias cleared by their net class

pairs_rule: each pair is judged on its own by totals_rule; the setting is accepted only if both pairs pass; pass_rule below is the paired rule the gate parser requires and is reported, not the verdict

boards.eligibility: all three boards; no board is dropped after a number
boards.board_flags: canary-pwr-9511d9a is routed from its DSN by the arm command; the two KiCad boards run through tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh, which strips tracks and vias and exports the DSN, with the arm command as the engine

grading: the KiCad boards: tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh (WSL KiCad 10.0.7). canary-pwr: canary's hardware/tools/grade.sh steps (ses_import.py, kicad-cli pcb drc --schematic-parity --refill-zones --severity-all, via_in_pad.py, inner_tracks.py) on WSL KiCad 10.0.7, calibrated by Q10.4's self-grade of mp1 (45 unconnected); the SESs also go to canary for the official grade

metric_definitions.class_via_clearance_errors: KiCad clearance violations (type clearance or hole_clearance) of which one item is a via whose net's class has a clearance above the default class's and the other item belongs to another net
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: KiCad's unconnected items after importing the session (canary: the count canary's grade prints; KiCad boards: grade.sh's routed count minus what the unrouted input reports)
metric_definitions.drc_real: KiCad copper errors other than unconnected items and starved thermals that the input does not already have

keep_rule: accept net_class (N05 then makes it enhanced's default) only if both pairs pass the totals rule; it stays an off-by-default setting either way, since it is a correctness fix KiCad's DRC asks for
stop_rule: one registered run per arm per board; no reruns with other settings
not_registered: canary-pwr placement variants a and b (canary-7a's exp-a/exp-b): only their add-only inputs exist outside canary, with Java's pass-1 routing (and its violations) fixed in; a pass-1 DSN needs canary's dsn_export.py on Windows KiCad
canary-pwr-1a7df77-addonly: add-only, so the violating vias are fixed input

decision_table.pass: Q14.3 [x]; DIVERGENCES line with the numbers; N05 adds router.via_clearance=net_class to enhanced
decision_table.fail: keep the setting off by default (it is a correctness fix); numbers and the failing clause in Q14.3's done note; operator decision
